summary: Hay Day entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Hay Day

emulation.notes: Use real mobile device capture unless an Android emulator is explicitly tested against current service behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Modern mobile device at native app resolution

primary.why: Hay Day is a live mobile farming game from Supercell, officially distributed on iOS and Android. Completeness depends on current account/event state rather than an alternate platform.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current App Store or Google Play build on a real mobile device. Record app version, account level, region, and active event/season state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record event state, account assumptions, and Supercell ID/login state. Hay Day Pop is a separate game.
